central_claim: At least two recruiting interventional trials (NCT05918640, NCT06571734) admit extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma on their eligibility criteria while their listed-conditions field never names the disease, so a condition search on the diagnosis would not surface them, and a keyword-built reachability map would in the same stroke wrongly admit two trials (NCT06094101, NCT07188532) that actually refuse the disease.

p1s.summary: No linter or gate in this repository recognises an ISRCTN identifier. The two ISRCTNs in section 4.1 (ISRCTN07742377, ISRCTN60791336) are correct at this pin but a transposed digit in either would pass every gate silently.
p1s.evidence: `research/manuscripts/lint_citations.py` PATTERNS (git show 227de322...:research/manuscripts/lint_citations.py, lines ~113-127) has exactly six kinds: PMID, PMCID, DOI, NCT, GEO, ARXIV — no ISRCTN entry. `python3 research/manuscripts/lint_citations.py` run against the live tree confirms this (exit 0, 1114 prose identifiers tracked, none of them ISRCTN-shaped). Both ISRCTNs do trace correctly to research/literature/non-us-registry-sweep-2026-08-09.json (ISRCTN07742377's verbatim exclusion criterion and ISRCTN60791336's parent-term exclusion are both present verbatim in that file at the pin), so this is a coverage gap in the instrument, not a defect in the paper's content — the same class of gap `lint_citations.py`'s own AUT-PD-057 comment records having existed and been closed for arXiv identifiers.
p1s.fix: Add an ISRCTN pattern (e.g. r'\bISRCTN(\d{8})\b' plus the isrctn.com URL form) to PATTERNS in lint_citations.py, anchored against non-us-registry-sweep-2026-08-09.json, and add a mutation test that flips one digit and confirms it goes red.

p1s.summary: Zero of this document's sentences, and zero of its numeric sentences, are read by any instrument. Every count in the paper (400/199/526 screen sizes, 1,159 unique studies, 42 conditions, seven-vs-ten conditions, twelve/five/three/seven damaged records, target enrolments 73 and 5500, age bounds) is correct at this pin but would drift silently under an ordinary future edit.
p1s.evidence: `research/manuscripts/claim-coverage.json` at the pin (git show 227de322...:research/manuscripts/claim-coverage.json) records for this document: {"sentences": 100, "covered": 0, "with_a_number": 26, "with_a_number_covered": 0, "uncovered": 100, "uncovered_with_a_number": 26}. `research/manuscripts/pinned-figures.json` at the pin lists this file only in `targets` (used by the superseded-value check), and its 99 `artifact_figures` entries contain zero matches for 'reachability', 'fet-fusion-trial' or 'non-us-registry'. I independently re-verified the load-bearing numbers by hand against the source JSON and all checked out (e.g. the 42-condition count for NCT06239272, the 23/23 re-run count in emc-hypoxia-therapeutic-status.json, and the five-record adjudication arithmetic in section 3/5) — the paper is correct now, but nothing would catch a future divergence.
p1s.fix: Add artifact_figures entries binding at minimum: NCT06239272's 42 listed conditions (fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json), the two admitting trials' target enrolments (73, 5500), the 1,159 unique-studies-indexed figure, and the adjudication summary tallies (emc-trial-reachability-adjudication-2026-08-09.json -> summary) — the exact quantity a prior round's arithmetic seat found broken (ARITH-B1, now fixed at this pin, per research/autonomy/hardening-state/PUB-STRATEGY-ARCH.json's round-3 record) and that nothing currently guards against recurring.
